name: greenflow-bond
description: Local-EVM demonstration of programmable green-bond proceeds controls

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @greenflow/shared build && pnpm --filter @greenflow/api build && pnpm --filter @greenflow/web build && pnpm contracts:build
scripts.chain:start: anvil --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8545 --chain-id 31337 --mnemonic "test test test test test test test test test test test junk" --silent
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names chain,api,web --prefix-colors green,cyan,magenta "pnpm chain:start" "pnpm --filter @greenflow/api dev" "pnpm --filter @greenflow/web dev"
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @greenflow/shared build && pnpm -r typecheck && node scripts/run-forge.mjs fmt --check --root packages/contracts
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @greenflow/shared build && pnpm --filter @greenflow/shared test && pnpm --filter @greenflow/api test && pnpm --filter @greenflow/web test && pnpm contracts:test
